results.title: UP Government Diwali Gift: Yogi Adityanath Approves Pay Scale Upgrade for 52 Officers
results.description: The Yogi Adityanath government has approved selection-grade pay scale upgrades for 52 Uttar Pradesh officers on the occasion of Diwali. The beneficiaries include officials serving in development authorities, district administrations, election offices, universities and other key government institutions.

results.title: Maharashtra Transport Minister Pratap Sarnaik Inaugurates 'Diwali Wonderland 2026' Carnival At Upvan Lake
results.description: Thane's Upvan Lake is hosting the six-day Diwali Wonderland 2026 carnival, featuring over 50 artists, music, dance and cultural performances. Organised by Yuva Sena, the event runs from November 6 to 11. Organisers said visitors can enjoy traditional attire contests, photography and reel-making competitions, a lucky draw and festive lighting.

results.title: Ayodhya Has Come Alive Once More...memories of Treta Yuga: CM Adityanath, Up Governor, Leads 10th Deepotsav Celebrations
results.description: Ayodhya celebrated its 10th Deepotsav with over 30 lakh diyas illuminating the Saryu Ghats. CM Yogi Adityanath, Governor Anandiben Patel and Vice President CP Radhakrishnan attended.

results.title: Trump's grip on his party is in question as Republicans reel from the midterm wipeout
results.description: Republicans are experiencing internal conflict following disappointing midterm election results, leading to discussions about their future direction. The party grapples with balancing traditional conservative values and the influences of Donald Trump. Many party members express the need for accountability and strategic regrouping after their electoral losses. There is a growing concern over regaining support from disenchanted voter demographics, particularly Latinos and young voters.
